chunks: (To which God) said: "This way is right by Me.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says 'This way is right by Me'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as God's direct address to the Prophet Muhammad or the Imams, designating the path of divine guidance as the 'straight path' (Sirat al-Mustaqim) free from deviation. It underscores the necessity of adhering to the Ahl al-Bayt as the living embodiment of this path, linking theological correctness with practical spiritual navigation. This affirmation serves as a foundational concept for understanding the continuity of divine authority (Imamah) after the Prophet.
